messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "do not switch without doctor changing dose"
set: ["do not switch without doctor changing dose", "do not switch between tablets and oral liquid without doctor changing dose", "do not switch to schedule without doctor", "do not change dose without doctor's advice", "do not start new medication without telling doctor", "do not start or stop without asking doctor", "do not stop without first talking to doctor", "do not change your dose or stop without talking to your doctor", "do not stop taking without talking to your doctor", "do not stop using without first asking your doctor", "do not stop without speaking to your doctor first", "ask doctor before changing dose or medication schedule", "do not change your dose", "do not take extra dose", "do not adjust dose yourself", "do not exceed recommended dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "do not change dose without doctor's advice",
    "do not change your dose or stop without talking to your doctor",
    "do not stop taking without talking to your doctor",
    "do not stop using without first asking your doctor",
    "do not stop without speaking to your doctor first",
    "do not change your dose",
    "ask doctor before changing dose or medication schedule"
  ],
  "alias": "do not change dose without doctor's advice"
}
